messages:
Maria (CS): Heads-up — we've been getting more feature asks during onboarding calls and it's messy. Can we agree a short capture template that the CS reps use in-call? We need fields that help Product prioritize and also flag renewal risk.

Jake (PM): Yes please. Can you sketch the minimum fields? ideally 6-8 items max so reps actually fill them.

Maria (CS): Thinking: 1) brief ask (1 line), 2) customer pain / job-to-be-done, 3) impact (quantitative if possible), 4) severity/urgency, 5) commercial ask (is this blocking deal/renewal?), 6) proposed owner (product/infra), 7) call snippet / quote, 8) account id / rep.

Ana (AE): Add "current workaround" and whether they would pay for it. Those two separate questions change prioritization a lot.

Sam (SE): Also add repro steps or example prompt + model used. If it's an integration ask, capture config details. Eg: "model: gpt-small, seq len 4096, error: 502 on upload".

Leo (Data): For Product, we'll want tags for taxonomy + a numeric "impact score" computed from impact/severity/payment intent. I can add a query to rollup counts by account and feature. Example SQL we'll run nightly: 
```sql
SELECT feature_tag, COUNT(*) AS requests, SUM(impact_score) AS total_impact
FROM cs_feedback
WHERE created_at >= current_date - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY feature_tag
ORDER BY total_impact DESC;
```

Jake (PM): Perfect. Can we keep the capture as a single-line form in the CS app and then expand to notes? We want structured fields for the rollups.

Olivia (CS Manager): Make this mandatory for accounts with NPS < 6 or renewal odds < 50%. Otherwise reps won't use it. Also need a short playbook excerpt: "When to escalate to AE/Product".

Maria (CS): Agreed. Proposed rollout: 1) draft template in Notion, 2) add to call checklist (CS app), 3) training doc + 20-min sync for reps, 4) enable nightly ETL that tags and scores entries. I'll draft the Notion template and ping execs.

feedback-bot: Created tracker: FB-4213 (Feedback template + ETL). Link: https://notion.fake/redwood/FB-4213

Ana (AE): Thx — can you add a quick example for a retail customer? helps reps copy format in the moment.

Maria (CS): Will do. ETA EOD tomorrow for initial draft. @Jake (PM) @Leo (Data) please review after I post.

Jake (PM): I'll review and add prioritization rubric. :thumbsup:

Olivia (CS Manager): Once live, I'll make it part of the onboarding checklist and include in weekly CS huddle.

Sam (SE): If you want, I can create a tiny snippet for the support modal to auto-fill model/environment fields. Saves time.

Maria (CS): That would help a lot — thanks. Closing loop: draft -> review -> ship -> train.
